title: Remove avoidable waits and duplicate guard parsing
goal: Preserve real filesystem exclusion, closure-result and post-release acquisition assertions while replacing an unnecessary default three-second contention wait with a zero-duration real attempt. Add zero-timeout coverage and strengthen existing positive-duration deadline coverage. Production lock code and deadlines remain unchanged. Native Windows execution and combined integration remain pending. Reuse one tokenization within each console-helper guard scan while preserving fresh filesystem reads, all launch and binding checks, diagnostics, and lexical-error coverage.
